page.overview:
What is Defense of Banchii?

The Defense of Banchii was carried out in 231 BBY when a farming settlement on the planet Banchii was attacked by the Drengir. The Drengir were able to kill several farmers before being stopped by members of the Jedi Order under the command of Jedi Master Arkoff and Jedi Knight Lily Tora-Asi.
